name: Seraph Horizons
description: The Seraph Horizons modpack's own mod. It holds the pack's tweaks, each one switchable in ModConfig/seraphhorizons.json: gameplay tweaks to other mods, and Tidy Variants, which hides orientation and open/closed variants and groups the remaining variants of each block or item into one creative tile and one handbook page (right-click a tile to expand its group).
